verification_report.summary: Checked all 1 proof items; 1 item(s) failed or were blocked.

critical_errors.location: pi_cce730f1dff58a14d9cf9ad0, proof of Proposition p213-normal-curve-arbitrary-valuation-current-revised, paragraph beginning “For the integration current”
critical_errors.issue: The claim that the coefficient of (F_trop)_*(delta_Y) on the primitive ray is exactly q_b(F) is false without generic quasi-smoothness. Ducros 4.5.21.4 identifies normalized slope with branch degree only for a generically quasi-smooth source; passing to completed perfect closure and then reduction can remove a generic inseparable/nilpotent multiplicity that the canonical CLD calibration still records through the local degree in Proposition 14.3.1. For example, for K=F_p((t)), L=K(t^(1/p)), Y=A^1_L viewed over K, and the moment F=T at a suitable type-3 point, perfect-closure reduction gives q_b(F)=1, while the finite map to A^1_K has local degree p, so the canonical pushforward of delta_Y has edge coefficient p. Consequently a_b=t_b/q_b is not normalized relative to delta_Y, and the subsequent divisor-functional and local-current-equality arguments do not establish T=c delta_Y.

gaps.location: pi_cce730f1dff58a14d9cf9ad0, proof of Proposition p213-normal-curve-arbitrary-valuation-current-revised, paragraph asserting propagation along every edge
gaps.issue: The proof merely asserts that the nodewise ratios c_y propagate along edges. Independence of the chosen moment at one point and balancing at one node do not by themselves compare ratios based at two different points. A common moment on an overlapping edge segment, constancy of its Euclidean edge coefficient, and constancy of the relevant lattice/calibration weight must be supplied.

gaps.location: pi_cce730f1dff58a14d9cf9ad0, proof of Lemma p213-variation-graph-source-cutoff, construction of chi
gaps.issue: CLD Corollary 15.2.5 supplies a smooth function equal to one near the compact set and compactly supported in W, but its stated conclusion does not include 0<=chi<=1. The proof omits the smooth postcomposition or stronger cutoff result needed to obtain the bounded nonnegative cutoff used for positivity.

repair_hints: [pi_cce730f1dff58a14d9cf9ad0] Either impose a generically quasi-smooth/geometrically reduced hypothesis or replace q_b(F) throughout by the actual canonical-calibration edge weight and prove its precise relation to normalized slope, including generic inseparable or nilpotent multiplicities under perfect-closure base change and reduction. Rework the intrinsic ratios, divisor functionals, and local equality with that corrected weight, explicitly checking the example Y=A^1_{K(t^(1/p))}. Also add an overlap argument proving spatial propagation of the corrected ratio and obtain 0<=chi<=1 by an explicit smooth postcomposition of the CLD cutoff.
